Name: Frog Tank Interactions and Frog Egg Chance
Author: Camileer
Description:
Click Sebastian’s frog tank once per ingame day for a little interaction: most days you’ll get a croak or a flavor line; sometimes you’ll find a small gift in the tank. And the frog now has a portrait.

By default there’s a small chance to find a Frog Egg. [b][i]A “More gifts” option is enabled by default[/i][/b], you can turn it off if you want Frog Eggs to be the only drop. You can tweak drop odds, rename the fallback frog/tank display name, and toggle other behavior via [b]GMCM [/b]or by editing the [b]JSON[/b].

[b][color=#00ff00][size=5]NEW, LATEST ADDITION

[/size][/color][/b][list]
[*][b]shift click your frog tank to name[/b] each one differently. If it has an unique name and not the fallback name (fallback name can be set in the config), [b]your frog counts as pet and you can give him treats or presents![/b]
[*]autodetection of some farmhouse changing mods to autodisable the vanillatank
[*]many new config options
[*]compatibility with SVE's tadpole
[*]more frog talk from some characters
[*]more frog portraits for some special dialogue options
[*][color=#ff0000]the static map tanks currently don't work with mods that add multiple spouserooms, but you can get a furniture tank from seb if you click "disable vanilla tanks" in the config[/color]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Standalone, placeable frog tanks[/b][/size]

You’re no longer limited to Sebastian’s room - place tanks anywhere.

How to earn one ingame:

[spoiler]Catch a Tadpole (Lake, Secret Woods, and a couple of hidden spots), be friends with Marnie, Jas, and Vincent, and have a rainy day. Bring the Tadpole in your inventory when you visit Marnie. (More routes coming soon)

Skip the quest (SMAPI console):


[spoiler]player_add (F)camiska.CPFrogTank_FrogTank[/spoiler][/spoiler]


Each tank now tracks its own daily interaction, even if you pick it up and place it again.

[size=4][b]Vanilla/static tank compatibility[/b][/size]

The vanilla Sebastian tank is upgraded with all the features above. You can hide or disable the vanilla/static tanks for better mod compatibility. If the static tank is missing/disabled (by this mod or another), the game should adapt with a small dialogue/event tweak so Sebastian gifts you a furniture tank after marriage.

Works for both farmers and farmhands married to Sebastian. Custom spouse rooms can get to work with a static tank with a CP Patch or you'll just go and disable static ones and use a furniture one. If yours needs a patch, let me know or read below.
[b][size=4]
 Extra textures & easy modding hooks[/size][/b]

Beautiful standalone tank textures by Zilchaz and Amaryn are bundled as an Alternative Textures pack (with permission). The AT folder is optional.
[b]For Map makers / mod authors:[/b]

[list]
[*] ﻿   Furniture tanks: use a 3×3 furniture (bounding box 3×2) with FurnitureAction(calclifer) camiska.FrogTank (generic) or camiska.SebFurnitureFrogTank (Sebastian-themed).
[*]  ﻿  Static map tanks: set tile Action=camiska.FrogTank (needs a tank sprite) on a 3×2 rectangle (if you want to include a static tank in Content Patcher packs). Or camiska.ModSpouseSebFrogTank if you want to patch a custom frog tank (needs a tank sprite) into a farmhouse.
[*]  ﻿  No animation/spawn logic needed, the mod handles the frogs.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

Drop the included subfolders directly into your Mods folder.

You’ll see three subfolders. The AT pack is optional, so installing only the other two is fine if you don’t use Alternative Textures.

[b][size=4]Multiplayer
[/size][/b]
Fully works in co-op for the player (or farmhand) married to Sebastian.

[b][size=4]Translators[/size][/b]

I’d love translations! No need to ask, just grab the two i18n/default.json files and go for it. You can upload translations as standalones or send me the  i18n files.

[b][size=4]Credits[/size][/b]

Most Art & all code by me, in the AT Pack the art from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7837](CP) Lively Frog Tank[/url] is by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/zilchaz?gameId=1303]Zilchaz [/url]and for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11080]Secret Garden Sanctuary[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/SugarSugarRuin?gameId=1303]Amaryn[/url], thanks so much for allowing their gorgeous textures to be bundled, and to Abagaianye, HeadInTheClouds amd Shrimply Forsy for their genius wording help. I also used assets from the Vanilla game, all credits to Concerned Ape.
Screenshots shown with Lively Frog Sanctuary and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1965]Elle’s Town Animals[/url] (the latter currently affects static/vanilla tanks).
